description: The tray menu is a webview window rather than a native menu (ADR 0012), so it needs a capability of its own. It draws a list and calls the suite's tray commands, and that is all: it never touches window state, the filesystem, or any other window. `core:window:allow-set-size` and `allow-set-position` are the two exceptions, because the menu measures its own content and reports the size it needs.
